title: EDX Markets and BitSafe launch centralised exchange trading for CBTC
message_html: EDX Markets and BitSafe launch centralised exchange trading for CBTC ...
snippet: EDX Markets, a digital asset technology firm that combines an institutional-only trading venue with a central clearinghouse, today announced a partnership with BitSafe to launch spot trading of CBTC, BitSafe’s Bitcoin-backed digital asset on the Canton Network.

title: Solana Labs’ Leap Launches Mobile App for Trading Tokenized Stocks and Crypto
message_html: Solana Labs’ Leap Launches Mobile App for Trading Tokenized Stocks and Crypto ...
snippet: Leap, built by the team behind Dialect, launched a beta iPhone app for trading tokenized stocks, ETFs, metals, currencies and crypto on Solana, pitching itself to traders looking beyond meme coins.
